expectations.text: The report distinguishes local module scope from broader project scope before recommending consolidation.
expectations.evidence: The report distinguishes module-refactor's local file/API/test layout from project-refactor's end-to-end runtime and safety scope.

expectations.text: The report identifies a concrete shape-based or policy-based candidate and explains its domain counterpressure.
expectations.evidence: The first candidate is the blanket stateless-class rule, with interface, DI, polymorphism, lifecycle, and safety counterpressure.

expectations.text: The report offers Keep, Simplify, Defer, and Escalate as the human decisions.
expectations.evidence: The first decision question lists all four states.

expectations.text: The report remains read-only and stops at the first candidate's decision.
expectations.evidence: The report states no edits were made and ends at the first decision.
